entries.content:
The Pixel 11 series: Your most personal Pixel yet

Discover the Google Pixel 11 lineup.

Aug 12, 2026 · 12 articles 12 Aug, 2026

articles 12

Aug 12, 2026 12 articles 12 Aug, 2026

articles 12

When it comes to our devices, we're committed to building experiences that help you make the most of your time — all while helping you stay connected and present with the people who matter most.

That's the vision behind the Pixel portfolio of products. We’re simplifying those daily moments where you turn to your phone to get things done, ensuring our latest products are purpose-built to help you throughout the day.

By leveraging our full vertical tech stack, our latest Pixel hardware is designed to help you reclaim the moment. Our approach is deeply personal, proactive, and productive, all with a single goal: to help you better navigate your life so you can get back to what you truly love.

Here’s everything we announced at Made by Google 2026.

entries.title: Now you can connect even more of your favorite apps and services to Gemini.
entries.summary: Connect your favorite services directly to Gemini to help you plan trips, manage projects and tackle your daily to-do list.
entries.content:
Today at Made by Google, we’re announcing that a new slate of connected apps are coming to Gemini to help you get more done. By turning on your favorite services in Gemini, you can easily plan, create, and tackle your to-do list all in one place.

Over the next few weeks, we’re rolling out the ability to connect with tools across a variety of categories:

  • Productivity and creativity: Summarize meetings and edit your website with Granola, Otter.ai, and Wix.
  • Local and entertainment: Book local experiences, rent a car, reserve your next dinner, and search for event tickets with Fever, GetYourGuide, Localiza, OpenTable (UK), and Ticketmaster.
  • Music: Discover new stations and stream your favorite playlists with iHeartRadio and Pandora.
  • Home, health, and lifestyle: Find a home professional with Angi or Thumbtack or book a doctor’s appointment with Zocdoc.

entries.title: Sharing between Pixel devices is now just a tap away.
entries.summary: Sharing between Android devices is even easier, starting with Pixel. Use Quick Share and tap to send contact info and more.
entries.content:
We’re making sharing between Android devices even simpler, starting with Pixel. Eligible devices can now use Quick Share and tap to send contact info, photos, videos, and more.

It’s easy to use, too — especially when you're swapping contact info. When you’re on your home screen, just bring your compatible Android device and another Android device close together for an instant, two-way exchange. To share photos or videos, open your phone’s Share Sheet and then tap the devices together. For more specifics, visit our Help Center.

The feature is rolling out today to Pixel 6 and newer devices, and it’s coming soon to the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Fold8, and Flip8. We’ll expand to more Android devices by the end of the year.

entries.title: 7 can’t-miss updates from our Pixel 11 launch
entries.summary: Thumbnail image of YouTube video for the launch of Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL
entries.content:
The new Pixel 11 lineup is designed for Gemini Intelligence 1 and delivers impressive camera upgrades. From all-new image sensors to proactive and personalized assistance, our latest hardware is built to help you navigate your day-to-day so you can stay present for what matters most.

1. Get timely support from Gemini Intelligence.

We’re introducing a bunch of updates that deliver timely, proactive help and help you get things done. On Pixel devices, Gemini can handle even more multistep tasks across your favorite apps, expanding to more than 40 apps and counting 1 along with plenty more features you’ll find first on Pixel.

That includes Rambler, 2 our Gemini-powered voice input feature, which is built for the way you actually talk. It delivers fast, accurate voice input that transcribes your point cleanly and concisely — even when you use filler words, like “um” and “ah.”

And beyond Rambler, we’re introducing a couple more updates right in Gboard. 3 Sign-to-text functionality, which uses Google DeepMind’s Sign Language-to-Text (SL2T) model, allows signers to naturally sign messages while enhanced writing tools help craft relevant, tailored messages in your own personal style.

And Pixel 11 will offer timely, helpful information through easily glanceable cards in the apps you’re already using. So, for example, if a friend asks about a trip that’s coming up, a card with your booking details will pop up along with details if your flight is on time or delayed. 4

You’ll also see suggestions that are contextually relevant to the conversations you’re having. Like when you’re texting about dinner while rushing out the door, Pixel can step in to help, offering a proactive prompt suggestion to lock down your reservation with just a tap. 5

You’ll see this type of proactive help in many more places across your phone — like suggestions to save events to your Calendar, locations to Maps, or relevant information to Google Wallet, like membership numbers on airline or hotel apps.

Launching in Preview, your phone will also provide location-based insights. 5 Like when you’re waiting for a table at a new restaurant, your lock screen will proactively show that location and, with just a tap, offer insights — such as top menu items or the most popular seats — from hundreds of reviews and photos, right in Google Maps.

2. Stay present with Magic Capture.

Life’s most precious moments can happen in a flash. And we don’t want you to miss living in the moment as you try to capture it. With Magic Capture, you’ll be able to automatically snap those blink-and-you’ll-miss-it baby smiles, playful pets, or hard-to-get action shots — like a basketball frozen in mid air — with a single tap, all while you stay present and engaged.

In a typical session, Magic Capture uses both on-device intelligence and Gemini models to analyze around 400 frames to deliver perfectly-timed, high-quality 12-megapixel photos. And Magic Capture can even automatically apply edits like crop and unblur, so your moments are ready to share. Even better, you’ll also get a video without needing to go back and forth between modes.

3. Pick your aesthetic with Camera Looks.

Camera Looks allows you to choose the exact aesthetic you’re going for, right at the point of capture. Because while the Original Pixel look is widely loved, we know everyone has their own preferences.

Now, you can set a new default photo look with three alternative options: Natural (for relaxed details), Shadows (for deeper contrast), and Vanilla (for a warm, golden glow). To create our Camera Looks, we made adjustments such as merging fewer frames for a minimally processed feel or rewriting color-lookup tables and more to emulate classic film chemistry.

If you want to add even more personal style to your photos, you can choose from six additional Looks: Digi, Black Tie, Minimal, Editorial, Classic, and Velvet. And every Camera Look is fully customizable so your photos will perfectly reflect your vision.

4. Make content more easily with Creator Suite.

Creator Suite makes content creation even easier on Pixel.

That includes handy tools right in your viewfinder — like social media gridlines or an on-screen teleprompter that dynamically scrolls as you talk — allowing you to frame recordings and speak at your own pace and never miss a word. You’ll also get more organizational support, with your captured videos saved directly into project folders. And once your video’s recorded, use Storyboard to effortlessly trim and rearrange your clips.

Plus, you can now set video as your default mode when you open Pixel Camera, so you’re always ready for action.

5. Take low-light pictures much faster.

Pixel has always been great at capturing the stars, and Instant Night Sight makes low-light photography better than ever on Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL. You’ll now be able to capture Night Sight images up to 4.5 times faster 6 while still retaining the quality you’ve come to expect. Because when you’re shooting in low light, you shouldn't have to choose between a great shot and holding still.

6. Circle to search right from your camera.

Use Circle to Search in your Camera viewfinder to learn about things you see. For example, if you’re exploring a botanical garden, you can quickly point your camera at a flower, zoom in for a closer look, and use Circle to Search to instantly identify the species, find planting tips, or get more information. 7

7. Translate real-world content without interruption.

Translate videos and audio in real time with Live Translate. This technology leverages Live Translate’s real-time speech-to-speech translation capability, advanced on-device generative AI models powered by our Google Tensor G6 processor, automatically dubbing media from around the world into your preferred language. 8

Order Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL today.

Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL are available for preorder today, starting at $899, $1,099, and $1,299, respectively.

All three phones will be on shelves at the Google Store and through our retail partners on August 20. Visit the Google Store for more information on availability and product updates.

entries.title: The Pixel 11 series: Your most personal Pixel yet
entries.summary: Close-up video of Pixel 11 Pro in Canyon
entries.content:
Today we unveiled Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL, which come with major camera upgrades, enhanced durability, and our fastest, most powerful chip, Google Tensor G6, that runs the latest Gemini Nano model. 1 These phones are designed for Gemini Intelligence to deliver time-saving, personal help 2 and include new camera experiences that will help you better capture the moment in your authentic style.

A refined design that’s built to last

All three phones feature a sophisticated design with edge-to-edge glass across the iconic Pixel camera bar.

And starting with Pixel 11, the camera bar's thickness was reduced by 40%, 3 making the phone virtually bumpless when paired with a Made by Google case. That means it’s more pocketable than ever and completely wobble-free on flat surfaces. Pixel 11 combines style and strength, housing a bright, immersive Actua display in a stunning satin metal frame with a polished glass back — and is engineered to withstand everyday splashes, scratches, and drops. 4

Pixel 11 comes in comes in two vibrant colors, Pistachio and Hibiscus, along with two elegant neutrals, Frost and Obsidian.

Back again in two sizes, our latest pro phones — Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL — deliver the ultimate Pixel experience. That starts with our brightest-ever Super Actua display, up to 3,600 nits, and a new anti-scratch display coating that delivers more than double the scratch resistance of the previous generation. 5 6 And when paired with our drop-resistant design introduced in our Pixel 9 series, these are our most durable Pro phones yet.

Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL are available in four elevated, fresh color options: Canyon, Fog, Olive, and an all-matte Obsidian.

All three phones start at 256GB of storage and feature our fastest charging yet, 7 including Pixelsnap built-in and — new to Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro — Qi 2.2 25W compatibility. As for wired charging, Pixel 11 Pro XL can now get you 15 hours of battery life in 15 minutes. 8

A connected experience, without the distraction

On Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL, HiLight will help you stay informed without having to look at your screen. It’s a delightful addition to our Pro devices that will keep you connected, not distracted, when your phone is face down.

Using colored LED lights built around the camera’s flash, HiLight will gently glow to notify you of timely, glanceable information. For example, when you prompt Gemini, it will glow in different patterns to signal that it’s listening, thinking, or responding.

And for incoming calls, you can assign custom colors to the people who matter most to you. It gives you confidence that you won’t miss anything critical, while staying focused on your task. It’s one of the many ways our latest hardware will help you be more present. And you can expect to see more capabilities added to HiLight over time — like message notifications from your favorite contacts.

A camera system built for priceless moments

All three phones include major upgrades across their camera systems.

Starting with Pixel 11, you’ll find a new, larger, 48-megapixel main sensor that delivers 56% more light sensitivity for some truly stunning photos and videos, even in challenging low-light environments. 9 And powered by Tensor G6, our 5x telephoto lens will now support 30x Super Zoom, getting you even closer to your subject. 9

Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL are also getting major camera upgrades.

Starting with the main lens, you’re getting a brand new sensor for Pixel’s best camera yet. 10 And for the telephoto, we have an upgraded 48-megapixel camera that delivers stunning quality across its full zoom range. We’ve completely redesigned it to include a larger image sensor with 30% more light sensitivity, 11 and we’ve enabled Portrait Mode at 5x, so you can have even more options to frame up the perfect shot. And thanks to Tensor G6, combined with our latest imaging models, you’ll also be able to see even further, with Pro Zoom at 120x. 12

Tensor G6 also plays a big role in elevating low light photography with its upgraded Image Signal Processor (ISP). And combined with redesigned software and improved sensors, Night Sight will now capture up to 4 and a half times faster, with the same excellent quality you’ve come to expect. 11

All powered by Google Tensor G6

Powering some of our most advanced camera experiences, Tensor G6 is our fastest, most powerful chip yet. 13

But we didn’t just build a faster chip; we built a purpose-driven engine designed to make your Pixel more intuitive, fluid, and helpful.

Tensor G6 features an upgraded CPU for 25% faster web browsing and 15% quicker app launches. 14 Packing 50% more TPU compute and paired with the latest Gemini Nano model, Google Tensor G6 processes on-device AI tasks up to 3.5 times faster while using up to 3.5 times less energy. 15 16

As technology evolves, so do the threats. Google Pixel is engineered specifically to help safeguard your most sensitive information from advanced attacks today and from risks like attacks by quantum computers in the future. Our new Titan M3 security chip and custom Tensor G6 processor seamlessly integrate to form our most robust, proactive defense system yet, bringing post-quantum cryptography to secure boot on your device.

Everything on your Pixel works together — the software, the hardware, the processor, and the AI — to give you real-world protection. And according to a new report by Counterpoint Research, our AI experience on Pixel has the most privacy protection on a phone. 17

Order Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL today

All of our latest phones come with seven years of OS, security, and Pixel Drop updates, and our Pro phones also come with six months of Google AI Pro, which includes higher usage for Gemini, 5TB of cloud storage, and Google Health Premium 18 19 Plus, we’re introducing new cases, including a Clear case, and refreshed Pixelsnap Ring Stand colors to mix and match.

Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL are available for pre-order today starting at $899, $1099, and $1299. All three phones will be on shelves at the Google Store and our retail partners on August 20. Visit the Google Store for more information on availability and product updates.

entries.title: Keep tabs on your valuables with Google Pixel Tag
entries.summary: Pixel Tag attached to a keychain, resting inside a small trinket box.
entries.content:
Introducing Google Pixel Tag, our first-ever finder tag. Helpful and secure, it uses Google’s Find Hub network to quickly and easily locate your favorite items. It’s great for your keys, wallet, or even luggage. 1

Tiny but mighty

Thin and light, Pixel Tag is made of durable stainless steel that’s designed to resist flexing and cracking, and is IP67 water- and dust-resistant. 2 It’s built with a speaker that can play a sound to help locate it, and it even works in reverse — it has a button you can press to ring and find your phone. 1

Pixel Tag has a long-lasting battery life, up to one year. And you can replace the battery yourself, with ease. 3

Simple to set up

To connect your tag, just pull the battery tab and bring the tag close to your Android device running Android 9 or newer. Follow the instructions on the screen, and it seamlessly pairs via Fast Pair. You can name items by selecting an item category or typing a custom label right in the Find Hub app 1 . And you can share Pixel Tag with up to 10 people to easily find shared items together. 4

Fast and secure finding

Open the Find Hub app to see your items on a map. If you misplace an item attached to the tag, you can ring it if you're within Bluetooth range. Ultra-Wideband with Bluetooth Channel Sounding also enables precision finding, with visual distance and directional cues for guidance. So you can find your missing items even when they’re under a pile of laundry or stuck between the couch cushions. 5

Left Behind alerts can be enabled to proactively help prevent leaving your items behind. 6 And if Pixel Tag is out of range, Find Hub taps into our massive network of over one billion Android devices to help you securely locate your missing belongings. This crowdsourced network uses safety features like end-to-end encrypted location information, protecting your data while helping you quickly reunite with your lost items.

Your phone will automatically alert you when it detects an unknown tag is traveling with you. It will also tell you how to ring the tag to help you find it and tips for what to do next.

Hands-free help from your other Pixel devices

Pixel Tag works with more than just your phone. You can locate and ring the tag right from your Pixel Watch, using the Find Hub app or browser. You can even use your Pixel Buds to ask Gemini to ring the tag for you.

Get yours from the Google Store

Purchase a Google Pixel Tag for $29, or snag a 4-pack for $99 when it hits shelves on November 11.

Visit the Google Store for more information on availability and product updates.

entries.title: Pixel Watch 5: Proactive assistance and advanced health tracking on your wrist
entries.summary: A close up video of the Pixel Watch 5
entries.content:
Last year, Pixel Watch 4 set a new standard for our smartwatches with its iconic design, long lasting ultra-fast charging battery, and on-wrist Gemini capabilities. Today, Pixel Watch 5 builds upon this foundation to change what a smartwatch can do, delivering our most proactive help and health experience yet. It’s designed for Gemini Intelligence, advanced fitness features with Google Health, and breakthrough new Health Guardian features. 1 2 3

Helpfulness at a glance

Pixel Watch 5 works silently in the background so you can stay present in the moments that matter most. At the center of this experience is At a Glance, which brings dynamic, context-aware updates directly to your watch face right when you need them. At a Glance ensures critical information is always right at hand — like surfacing live boarding passes as you step into the airport or showing remaining stops on your morning commute.

Interacting with your watch is even faster and more fluid thanks to major enhancements to Raise to Talk, our most popular way to interact with Gemini. 4 Simply lift your wrist to engage Gemini to launch a workout, set a timer, or pull up dinner reservations straight from Gmail. Powered by on-device AI, core actions now process instantly with low latency, even when you’re completely offline.

Building on that foundation, Gemini Intelligence Proactive Suggestions turns complex, multi-step tasks into seamless one-tap actions. 2 If a loved one asks when is the dinner with family, Gemini automatically locates the info in your calendar and surfaces it directly on your wrist, eliminating the need to dig through your phone.

To make taking action effortless while staying in the moment, intuitive one-handed gestures work hand-in-hand with these proactive suggestions. When a timely proactive suggestion surfaces, you can select, confirm and send with a simple double pinch gesture, keeping your interactions fast and hands-free.

All of this helpfulness is driven by powerful new hardware under the hood. Powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon® W5 Gen 2 Accelerated processor and a power-efficient dual-chip architecture, Pixel Watch 5 packs 50% more RAM and a 12% CPU boost — making it 20% faster so every proactive insight and action feels instant. 5

Advanced health and fitness, enhanced with Google Health Coach

Precision remains our cornerstone, and Pixel Watch 5 delivers our most accurate GPS route tracking yet — offering 2x greater accuracy compared to previous generations in the toughest environments. 5 Whether you’re running through dense high-rises or navigating covered trails, your watch delivers pinpoint location tracking even in the most challenging environments.

We leveraged the advanced technology behind Google Maps to trace satellite ray paths through 3D building models. Pixel Watch 5 also taps into a global network of weather reference stations in real time, adjusting satellite readings to account for local atmospheric conditions as they happen.

This combination of 3D environmental modeling, AI driven optimizations, and atmospheric corrections elevates route precision to a whole new tier. Pixel Watch 5 has our most accurate GPS route tracking for exercise, outperforming Apple Watch Ultra 3 and Garmin Fenix 8 Pro. 6

We know fitness goes far beyond cardio. Building strength is essential for long-term health, but structuring balanced workouts and staying on track during a session can be challenging. Coming soon, our new on-wrist Strength Training workout experience brings step-by-step guidance directly to your wrist, helping you move through sets and rest periods while making it easy to log your weights and reps on the go. 7

Google Health Coach also creates customized strength workouts tailored to your goals. You can also build and customize your own strength routines directly in the Google Health app. Beyond workout planning, Google Health Coach translates recovery metrics like your sleep and heart rate variability into adaptive recommendations — such as swapping an intense run for indoor yoga during an afternoon heat wave. 8

When it's time to recharge, Pixel Watch 5 and Google Health Coach elevate sleep tracking with 15% more accurate sleep stage detection, bedtime automations that automatically pause audiobooks when you drift off, and a dedicated bedtime watch face. 9 10 When morning comes, Smart Wake ensures you wake up feeling refreshed. By monitoring your heart rate and movement during the 30 minutes leading up to your alarm, Smart Wake identifies optimal moments of lighter sleep to gently wake you before your set alarm time. 11

Take steps to improve wellness with Health Guardian features and more

Health Guardian features 7 can catch subtle shifts in your health and wellness before they escalate into bigger issues. Pixel Watch 5 builds on crucial, potentially life-saving features like Loss of Pulse Detection and satellite communications by introducing an industry-first feature to the wrist: breathing emergency detection. 12 13 14 15 Powered by multimodal sensors — including PPG, accelerometer, and barometer — alongside on-device AI, Pixel Watch 5 continuously monitors for severe, persistent drops in oxygen saturation that can result from drug toxicity accidents, severe pneumonia, or choking. If a breathing emergency is detected and you are unresponsive, your watch can automatically call emergency services and transmit your exact location (launching first in Europe).

While emergency response is critical, taking steps toward improving your health is also about seeing the full picture, catching quiet, invisible trends before they become emergencies. Joining established capabilities in the Google Health app like irregular heart rate notifications, high and low heart rate alerts, and ECG, we're introducing three additional groundbreaking Health Guardian features. 11 16

Built on state-of-the-art Health Foundation Models trained on billions of minutes of sensor data from opted-in users and rigorously validated against gold-standard clinical measurements, these models power three new monthly trend summaries: blood pressure trends, sleep breathing quality trends, and insulin resistance trends. 7 17 18 19 7 Rolling out soon — with your first detailed summary arriving after one month of wear — these reports illuminate metabolic, respiratory and cardiovascular shifts early, giving you clear insights to help you take control of your long-term health. Plus, monthly summaries will soon be available across our wearable portfolio, including the new Google Fitbit Air. 20

By bringing together proactive Gemini Intelligence, our most precise GPS engineering, personalized strength coaching with step by step directions (coming soon), and innovative Health Guardian features, Pixel Watch 5 delivers the insights, safety, and speed you need, right when you need them most. 2 3

Iconic design and fresh colors

Here are even more details about the new Pixel Watch 5:

  • A stunning 3,000-nit domed Actua 360 Display.
  • 11 new glanceable complications styles.
  • Two new stunning watch faces.
  • Brand new generative watch faces to emulate your personal style. 21
  • Up to 30 hours of battery life on the 41mm (40 hours on the 45mm) with fast charging. 22 23
  • Industry-leading repairable architecture. 21
  • New color options including Fog, Canyon (41mm exclusive), and Olive with all-new Pyrite housing.
  • Ultra-comfortable HNBR brands. 24
  • A Stephen Curry Special Edition (45mm) that features an exclusive sweat-wicking performance loop band, taking style from the court to an evening out.

Pixel Watch 5 is available for pre-order starting August 12 and will be on shelves August 20, starting at $399 (41mm) and $429 (45mm). The Stephen Curry Special Edition pre-orders start August 12 for $579, arriving on-shelf September 3.

entries.title: Here’s your first look at the newest Pixel devices.
entries.summary: Here’s a first look at our new Pixel devices, including new Pixel 11 phones, Pixel Watch 5, and our first-ever Pixel Tag.
entries.content:
Today, we unveiled new Pixel devices — including new Pixel 11 phones, Pixel Watch 5, and our first-ever Pixel Tag. Here’s a look at everything in the lineup.

Our new phones — Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold — are designed for Gemini Intelligence. 1 They’re more durable and include major camera upgrades that help you capture the moment in your authentic style.

Pixel Watch 5 delivers proactive Gemini Intelligence capabilities, personalized strength coaching, and our most accurate GPS route tracking. It also offers breakthrough Health Guardian features, like blood pressure and insulin resistance trends and breathing emergency detection — an industry-first for a smartwatch.

Our first-ever finder tag, Pixel Tag, uses Google’s Find Hub network to help you locate your favorite items. It’s made of durable stainless steel and has a long-lasting battery, and its built-in speaker plays a sound when prompted.

Visit the Google Store for more information on availability and product updates.

entries.title: New accessories for Pixel 11 phones are here.
entries.summary: Google is rolling out new Pixel accessories as part of Made by Google
entries.content:
New Pixel 11 accessories are here, including brand-new Pixelsnap cases and Pixelsnap Ring Stand colors.

Pixelsnap cases are available in a variety of colors designed to match your phone and style, including one that’s not a color at all. For the first time, we’re excited to offer clear cases that showcase your phone's original design. Other colors include Frost, Obsidian, Pistachio, and Hibiscus for Pixel 11; Canyon, Fog, Olive, and Obsidian for Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL; and Olive and Obsidian for Pixel 11 Pro Fold.

Whether you’re looking to protect your device or refresh its look, these cases offer the perfect blend of durability and style. And, they’re Pixelsnap compatible, so you can attach thousands of magnetic accessories.

We’re also introducing three new Pixelsnap Ring Stand colors: Canyon, Olive, and Obsidian. It’s all part of elevating your Pixel experience with style and protection built for everyday life.

entries.title: Here’s what’s new with Pixel Buds Pro 2 and Pixel Buds 2a.
entries.summary: Google is launching a new color and upgraded features for Pixel Buds Pro 2 and Pixel Buds 2a as part of Made by Google.
entries.content:
Pixel Buds are getting even better with new features, plus a new Olive finish for Pixel Buds Pro 2. Here are the details:

  • Dynamic ANC: Pixel Buds Pro 2 will adjust to compensate when subtle shifts in the seal happen, so you still get powerful noise cancellation.
  • Gemini audio control: Adjust your Buds’ settings with Gemini. Just say “Hey Google, turn up the bass.”
  • Pixel Watch sleep sync: Your watch detects when you fall asleep and pauses music, disables touch, and silences notifications, so you can rest undisturbed.
  • Upgraded Live translate: Tap your Buds to trigger listening mode and understand over 70 languages in near real time without touching your phone. And it's not just for listening — speak to someone in your language, and your Pixel phone will play the translation back to the other person in theirs.

Order Pixel Buds Pro 2 in Olive starting August 12, and software updates start rolling out in September.
